title: RRB Station Master 2026: last date 25 November

scenes.h: Station Master jobs · last date 25 Nov
scenes.say: Railway Station Master jobs! About twelve hundred and sixty five posts across all Railway Recruitment Boards. The last date to apply is the twenty fifth of November.

items: Any graduate, degree complete by 25 Nov 2026
scenes.say: Who can apply? Any graduate, with the degree completed by the twenty fifth of November. Age twenty to thirty three, as on the first of January twenty twenty seven. O B C get three years more, and S C and S T get five years more.
The starting basic pay is thirty five thousand four hundred rupees. Selection is a computer based test, then an aptitude test, then document verification and medical.

items: ₹250 for SC/ST, women and other listed groups
scenes.say: Apply only on R R B apply dot gov dot in, before eleven fifty nine P M on the twenty fifth of November. The fee is five hundred rupees, and four hundred comes back after you take the exam. It is two hundred and fifty rupees for S C, S T, women and other listed groups.
